Italian Pasta with Zucchini is my go to dinner for those nights when I want something light but still really satisfying. You know the feeling, you are hungry, you want pasta, but you do not want a heavy sauce or a huge sink full of dishes. This recipe hits that sweet spot with fresh zucchini, juicy tomatoes, and just enough olive oil and cheese to make it feel special. It is quick enough for a weeknight, but it also feels kind of pretty when you plate it. If you have a couple of summer veggies hanging out in your fridge, this is exactly what to do with them. ## Pasta with zucchini and tomatoes. This is the kind of pasta I make when I want my dinner to taste like it came from a little Italian place, but I also want to stay in sweatpants. The zucchini turns silky in the pan, the tomatoes get jammy and bright, and the whole thing coats the pasta without needing a real sauce. It is simple food, but it has a lot of flavor if you treat the ingredients right. You can keep it vegetarian, or you can add protein if you have it. If you are in a chicken mood, my other weeknight favorite is lemon chicken pasta with herbs, and it pairs with the same bright, fresh vibe. **Italian Pasta with Zucchini** is also a nice choice when you are trying to eat lighter without feeling like you are giving something up. If you want to make it a bit more filling without changing the vibe, you can add a spoon of ricotta on top or a handful of mozzarella pearls. ## How to make pasta with tomatoes and zucchini. And yes, this is the recipe I make when I want **Italian Pasta with Zucchini** but I only have 30 minutes and zero patience for complicated steps. It is quick, it is light, and it is full of real flavor from zucchini, tomatoes, garlic, and good olive oil.
